slides.title: Why the Hampton West lives larger than 1,322 square feet.
slides.alt: Kitchen in the Hampton West with white cabinets, stainless appliances, two pendant lights over a large island, and a vaulted ceiling.

slides.label: Private entry
slides.title: A private way in.
slides.body: Your own front door, your own stair, and an attached two-car garage. The walk from the car to the fireplace never goes outside.
slides.alt: Slate blue front door with a divided-light window, white trim, gray siding, and stone accents.

slides.label: Open concept
slides.title: One open room, anchored by a fireplace.
slides.body: The living room, dining space, and kitchen share one vaulted space, so the square footage works together instead of being divided up.
slides.alt: Open living area with plank flooring and a gas fireplace with a white mantel, opening to the kitchen and island under a vaulted ceiling.

slides.label: Kitchen
slides.title: A kitchen that faces the room.
slides.body: Stainless appliances, subway tile, under-cabinet lighting, and a full island that looks out to the living room, so the cook stays part of the conversation.
slides.alt: Kitchen work area with subway tile backsplash, stainless dishwasher and refrigerator, under-cabinet lighting, and the island in the foreground.

slides.label: Vaulted ceilings
slides.title: Height a floor plan never shows.
slides.body: Vaulted ceilings over the main living space, with pendant lights and a ceiling fan, make every square foot feel taller and wider.
slides.alt: Vaulted ceiling with a ceiling fan and two pendant lights above the kitchen island, looking toward the open dining space.

slides.label: Two bedrooms
slides.title: Two bedrooms, both with room to breathe.
slides.body: Ceiling fans in both bedrooms and a wide double window here. A guest room, an office, or both.
slides.alt: Bedroom with a ceiling fan, gray walls, plank flooring, and a wide double window.

slides.label: Two full baths
slides.title: Two full baths. No waiting.
slides.body: One with a tub and shower, one with a glass-door shower.
slides.alt: Left, a bathroom with a white tub and shower combination. Right, a bathroom with a glass-door shower and a vanity with a speckled countertop.

slides.label: Walk-in closet
slides.title: A closet you can walk into.
slides.body: Shelving and hanging rods on two walls, with room for the whole wardrobe, not just this season's.
slides.alt: Walk-in closet with white wire shelving and hanging rods on two walls.

slides.label: Laundry room
slides.title: A laundry room, not a laundry closet.
slides.body: A full-size washer and dryer, upper cabinets, a folding counter, and a door that closes on all of it.
slides.alt: Laundry room with a full-size white washer and dryer, dark wood upper cabinets, a wire shelf, and a white folding counter.

slides.title: The Hampton West at Southwind Prairie.
slides.alt: Summary card: The Hampton West at Southwind Prairie, 1,322 square feet on the upper level, 2 bedrooms, 2 full baths, attached two-car garage, private stair and entry, gas fireplace, private deck, walk-in closet, full-size washer and dryer. Call (262) 249-8500.

caption: Square footage is a number. A floor plan is how it feels.

The Hampton West at Southwind Prairie is 1,322 square feet on the upper level, and it lives larger than that. Swipe through: a private entry with an attached two-car garage, one open vaulted space for the kitchen, dining, and living room, a gas fireplace, an island that faces the room, two bedrooms with ceiling fans, two full baths, a walk-in closet, and a true laundry room with a full-size washer and dryer. Call (262) 249-8500 to make it yours.
